test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: One morning Abhay started walking from his home. He walked 500 m toward the south and then turned to the right. After walking 300 m he turned to the left and walked 500 m. In which direction is he from his house now? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information:

He walked 500 m toward the south and then turned to the right. 

After walking 300 m he turned to the left and walked 500 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9fe4557ab11e4f860a3f686798ee6918257a4635f4aad2d2cbded46dc47c864.png] 

Now, he is in **South-west **direction from his house.

Hence, the correct answer is** "South-west".**
